description: Let the agents work on a run from start_o2c_demo or start_o2c_run until they need the founder, the run ends, or up to "steps" actions (about 25 seconds at most). Returns what each agent did, every order's status and the totals. When exceptions are waiting, call list_o2c_exceptions.

title: Advance an order-to-cash run
